source: Static VWSC parse of SnowCraft.exe movie (never executed). Director blend 255 = transparent, 0 = opaque. Phaser alpha = 1 - blend/255.
decoder: ScummVM engines/director/images.cpp BITDDecoder D4+ 32-bit: PackBits, each row is A,R,G,B planes of width bytes. SnowCraft 32-bit text BITDs have unused (0) alpha; white is the matte.

levelWord.note: Level 6 uses ink 39 (darkest) on the word channel; digit is still ink 8.

levelDigits.note: CASt registration is spec+18/+20 minus initialRect (ScummVM D6–D11 bitmap.cpp). 8-bit 2–4 sit ~50px right of 'Level'. 32-bit 5–9 fan left-to-right; 5–7 overlap the word. Wired as recovered, not inferred 2–4 alignment. EXE not run.

playfield.note: Present on Event Loop ch2 but blend 255 (hidden during play).

paletteStrip.name: snowcraft_palatte
paletteStrip.note: 8-bit BITD; not a GAME OVER/YOU WIN glyph. Left unwired (palette/credit strip).

notPresent: No GAME OVER BITD. Loss screen is the Happy Holidays logo plus Lingo Play Again / SCORE.
No YOU WIN BITD. Victory banner is member 88 Congratulations! then the logo.
